Hi team —

Assembling the ground plan — please confirm the items below by end of day tomorrow:
- BlueLine: driver assignments and meet-and-greet at arrivals (names + cell numbers). Can you confirm vans for the 9/7 evening arrivals and three 6-passenger vans for 9/8 am window?
- Dev: can you confirm rental cars for the two execs (premium sedans), pickup/return times, and which corporate card will be used?
- Grace: parking passes for on-site team + vendor drop-off window (we need 3 passes near Loading Dock B).

I've attached the transfer_manifest.csv (passenger names, flight numbers, hotel). If we need a backup rideshare plan for late flight delays, propose fallback vendor and estimated cost per ride.

Thanks — trying to lock this down before final schedule goes to Aperture later this week.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Events, Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn / team —

Thanks for the manifest. We can cover the two 9/7 evening pickups with one 6-pass executive SUV and one town car. For 9/8 morning we can provide three 6-pass vans staged at SFO curb (Meeting point: Terminal 1, Door 6) with two dedicated drivers on standby. Driver names and mobile numbers will be provided 48 hours prior.

Quick notes:
- Estimated quote for the scope (airport pickups + 2 days on-site shuttle): $2,050 (see attached quote).
- All vehicles are COVID-clean standard and we supply bottled water.
- For delayed flights, we charge a $35 extended wait fee per pickup after 30 minutes.

Attached: blueline_quote.pdf

Let me know if you want us to invoice Redwood or Aperture directly; we can accept on-hold billing for corporate PO.

Best,
